newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Cadenalco '96 net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Cadenalco '96 net profit up.

text.p: Cadenalco, Colombia's largest retailer on terms of size and sales, said its net profit rose to 27.3 billion pesos in 1996 from 17.5 billion in 1995.
The group, which is owned by the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, operates in five different retail formats, including two supermarket chains and two general merchandise chains.

It said a shareholders' meeting would be held on March 7 where it would propose that 8.14 billion of the 1996 profit be distributed in the form of a monthly dividend totaling 3 pesos per share. The dividend would be payable from March of this year through February 1998, it said.
